# Untermoos

> A whole Tyrolean farmhouse (about 200 years old, 300 m²) for up to 10 guests in Glatzham, Breitenbach am Inn, in the Alpbachtal, Tyrol, Austria. Let by its owners directly; enquiries are answered personally within 24 hours. German site at /, English at /en/.

Key facts
- 4 bedrooms, 10 beds (ground-floor double; upstairs four-bed room, two-bed room, double), bathrooms with tub and shower, 4 WCs
- Tiled stove (Kachelofen) in the original Stube, wood-fired range in the kitchen, timber balcony across the front, garden with playground and barbecue, fenced area for up to 2 dogs, parking at the house
- Elevation 640 m; Ski Juwel Alpbachtal Wildschönau (Reitherkogelbahn) about 25 min by car; SkiWelt Wilder Kaiser about 30 min; Zillertal about 40 min; Kitzbühel about 55 min; Innsbruck about 50 min; Munich about 1 h 25
- Rates for the whole house from €390 per night (low season) to €1,150 (New Year week); minimum stay 3–7 nights by season
- Included: final cleaning, bed linen and towels, electricity, heating and firewood, Wi-Fi, parking, Alpbachtal Card (free mountain lifts in summer, regional and ski buses)
- Extra: tourist tax €3.50 per person aged 15+ per night; dogs €12 per night
- Booking: enquiry form with instant indicative price → personal offer within 24 h → 30 % deposit, balance 30 days before arrival
